method.boundaryAllowance: Modeled crown plus 0.15 m stays inside parcel
method.rootSpaceAllowance: 1 m centre-to-hardscape, furniture and stepping stone clearance; conceptual, not actual root-ball dimensions
method.objective: 0.6 mean plus 0.3 minimum coverage among sofa, standing living-room, jacuzzi and garden, plus 0.1 earlier weighted 17-position score.
method.verification: All reported counts independently checked against full analyzeVisibility.
method.caveat: Dense ideal catalog-sized crown volumes. Not a global optimum, future growth forecast or guaranteed opaque foliage.

optimisticCornerUnion.description: Union of every accepted 0.25 m grid crown plus all reported refined corner positions, ignoring mutual spacing and the three-tree limit. This is a sampled-region feasibility diagnostic, not a realizable planting or continuous upper bound.
